events.title: Opera 15 on Chromium released
events.summary: Opera shipped version 15 on July 2, 2013 built on Chromium and Blink — completing the switch from the in-house Presto engine (a beta had shipped May 28, 2013).
events.about: Opera abandoned its own rendering engine to focus on features like Turbo compression and cross-device sync while riding Chromium's compatibility. The move mirrored the industry's consolidation: maintaining a unique engine was too expensive when sites targeted Chrome first.

narrative.whyChosen: Opera's engine switch left Firefox's Gecko as the last major independent lineage outside WebKit/Blink.
narrative.whyImportant: It signaled that even innovative browser vendors could not sustain proprietary engines alone.
narrative.problemSolved: Presto could not keep up with Chrome's pace; Opera needed Chrome-compatible rendering without rebuilding from scratch.

events.title: ESLint first released
events.summary: Nicholas Zakas introduced ESLint on July 16, 2013 — a pluggable JavaScript linter with every rule configurable at runtime.
events.about: ESLint parses code into an AST and runs shareable rules — catch unused variables, enforce style, or ban dangerous patterns. Plugins extend it for React, TypeScript, and Node. Teams ship `.eslintrc` configs in open source and CI. It replaced JSHint as the default linter for modern JavaScript projects.

narrative.whyChosen: ESLint made lint rules pluggable when JSHint could not be extended for project needs.
narrative.whyImportant: It became the standard gatekeeper for JavaScript quality in editors and CI pipelines.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams needed custom static analysis rules that existing linters could not add.

events.title: Nokia Lumia 1020 released
events.summary: Nokia released the Nokia Lumia 1020 — 41 MP PureView camera — photography-focused Windows Phone.
events.about: Nokia hardware shaped pre-iPhone smartphones and later Microsoft's mobile platform bet. 41 mp pureview camera — photography-focused windows phone.

narrative.whyChosen: The Nokia Lumia 1020 was a flagship Nokia smartphone milestone.
narrative.whyImportant: Nokia devices defined mobile platforms from Symbian through Windows Phone.
narrative.problemSolved: Mobile users needed capable smartphones before the iPhone/Android era matured.
